description: Across the dark castle lake, Koldinghus shows red-brick wings and, on the ruined side, grey-brown oak-shingle walls and a tall open timber tower. The timber reads as the modern restoration, not as medieval fabric. It is overcast, about 11.4°C, and the bank is empty. Joints in the timber are a generated interpretation, not a measured survey of the Exner structure.
